proposals.title: PROPOSAL NO. 4 —STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL— REPORT ON NEAR- AND LONG-TERM GREENHOUSE GAS EMISSIONS TARGETS
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report disclosing near- and long-term GHG reduction targets aligned with Paris Agreement 1.5 degrees Celsius goal and a plan to achieve them, covering operational and supply chain emissions.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends that you vote AGAINST the proposal
